questions.q: The basic structure doctrine was first laid down by the Supreme Court in which case?
options: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973)
Indira Nehru Gandhi v. Raj Narain (1975)
Minerva Mills v. Union of India (1980)
questions.why: Kesavananda Bharati held that Parliament may amend any part of the Constitution but cannot damage its basic structure. Golaknath is the near-miss: it barred amendment of Fundamental Rights outright, and Kesavananda overruled it.

questions.q: The withdrawal of the south-west monsoon from India begins in which region?
questions.why: Retreat starts over north-west India in early September and moves south-east, the reverse of the onset, which begins over Kerala around 1 June.

questions.q: The Nagoya Protocol, adopted in 2010, deals principally with which of the following?
options: Liability and redress for damage from living modified organisms
Access to genetic resources and fair sharing of benefits from their use
Trade in endangered species of wild fauna and flora
questions.why: Nagoya is the access-and-benefit-sharing protocol under the CBD. The first option describes the Nagoya–Kuala Lumpur Supplementary Protocol, which is the trap; the third is Stockholm and the fourth is CITES.
